_meta.what: Follow-the-money: land-value capture in Chennai. Two documentable poles: (1) the IT-corridor (OMR / Rajiv Gandhi Salai) where the state manufactured the uplift via FSI exemptions and state-developed IT parks (SIPCOT Siruseri, TIDEL/ELCOT) — the FSI-exemption G.O. is a Tier-A documented instrument; and (2) the Cooum/Adyar riverfront 'restoration' eviction-and-redevelopment, where the eviction/resettlement figures are documented (Tier-A) and the displacement-to-distant-ghettos critique is Tier-C analysis. CMDA is the improvement-trust descendant that took planning/land from the corporation in 1972.

tier_legend.B: reported allegation (attributed; denial noted where available)

_meta.authoritative_sources: CMDA Second Master Plan (notified TN Gazette 2 Sep 2008); G.O.Ms.13 Information Technology Dept (16 Aug 2002) designating ELCOT certifying authority for FSI exemption; SIPCOT/ELCOT records; HLRN 'From Deluge to Displacement' (post-flood eviction study); established press (The News Minute, The Caravan, Undark, acjnewsline). Eviction figures are from settlement enumerations cited in the HLRN study and press.

actors.actor: ELCOT / SIPCOT (state IT-corridor land + FSI exemption)
actors.role: State agencies that assembled, exempted and developed the OMR IT corridor: SIPCOT (industrial-park land at Siruseri), ELCOT (IT-park certifying/FSI authority), TIDCO/TIDEL (TIDEL Park)
actors.how_they_profit: The state manufactures the corridor uplift directly: it assembles cheap peri-urban land into IT parks AND grants FSI/CMDA-norm exemptions that multiply the buildable value, then the office economy revalues all adjacent private land — value capture engineered by exemption rather than auction.
actors.mechanism: FSI exemption; state IT-corridor land assembly; land-value capture
actors.project: OMR / Rajiv Gandhi Salai IT corridor; SIPCOT IT Park, Siruseri (~782-868 acres); TIDEL Park
actors.claim: DOCUMENTED FACT: By G.O.Ms.No.13, Information Technology Department, dated 16 Aug 2002, the Tamil Nadu government designated ELCOT as the certifying authority for development of IT parks and for availing EXEMPTION from FSI and other norms from the CMDA. SIPCOT developed the Siruseri IT Park (reported ~782.51 to ~868 acres; 36 plots, anchor tenants incl. TCS, Hexaware, Polaris) along the corridor. The CMDA Second Master Plan (notified TN Gazette, 2 Sep 2008) explicitly designates the SIPCOT IT Park and zones the corridor.
actors.source: G.O.Ms.No.13 IT Dept (16 Aug 2002) as cited in ELCOT/IT-park documentation; SIPCOT IT Park (Wikipedia/SIPCOT records); CMDA Second Master Plan 2008 (TN Gazette).

actors.role: Metropolitan planning and land authority (1972/1974), which took planning/land powers from the corporation; master-plan and FSI/zoning regulator over ~1,189 sq km
actors.how_they_profit: Controls the zoning, FSI and master-plan levers that determine where land value is created or released along the corridor; the unelected body that holds the rent-rich planning function the elected Greater Chennai Corporation does not.
actors.mechanism: FSI/zoning control; land-value capture via development authority
actors.project: CMDA Second Master Plan 2026 (notified 2 Sep 2008); OMR corridor zoning
actors.claim: ANALYSIS: CMDA is Chennai's improvement-trust descendant — planning and land were carved out of the elected corporation in 1972, and CMDA now holds the FSI/zoning/master-plan levers (Second Master Plan, 1,189 sq km) that decide where corridor land value is manufactured and released. The atlas scorecard records Chennai keeping the 'broom' (conservancy, roads) while the rent-rich land/planning function sits with CMDA — Ghosh's depoliticised 'improvement' move repeated.
actors.source: docs/the-corporate-city.md (Chennai devolution); service_providers.json (CMDA as state board, planning/land taken from corporation 1972); CMDA Second Master Plan 2008.

actors.actor: Tamil Nadu Slum Clearance Board (TNSCB) / Greater Chennai Corporation — Cooum & Adyar riverfront eviction
actors.role: Agencies executing the post-2015-flood 'river restoration' evictions of riverbank settlements and resettlement to peripheral sites
actors.how_they_profit: Clearing riverbank settlements frees centrally-located riverfront land for 'restoration'/redevelopment while moving the poor to distant peripheral colonies — the eviction-redevelopment that converts occupied central land into a planning/real-estate asset.
actors.mechanism: eviction-redevelopment; riverfront land assembly; mega-project justification
actors.project: Cooum & Adyar 'river restoration'; resettlement to Kannagi Nagar (Ezhil Nagar) and Perumbakkam
actors.claim: DOCUMENTED FACT: Settlement enumerations recorded ~14,972 families in 65 Cooum settlements and ~9,687 families in 28 Adyar settlements. Following CM announcements of 7 and 29 Dec 2015, riverbank families were moved to Kannagi Nagar and Perumbakkam on Chennai's outskirts; of the 9,687 Adyar families, ~3,464 were shifted by June 2016. Reporting puts 16,000+ families already relocated by Cooum/Adyar restoration, with tens of thousands more slated. TNSCB enumerated 6,257 and GCC surveyed 3,430 families in specific drives.
actors.source: HLRN 'From Deluge to Displacement: The Impact of Post-flood Evictions and Resettlement in Chennai'; The News Minute 'Hundreds of families along Chennai's Cooum evicted'; Undark 'In India's Chennai, River Restoration Lands Hardest on the Poor'; acjnewsline (Indira Nagar slum).
actors.denial_if_any: The Tamil Nadu government defends the evictions as flood-mitigation 'river restoration' and rehabilitation into permanent housing; civil-society studies (HLRN) contest the environmental and socio-legal rationale, citing distant relocation into flood-prone peripheral ghettos.

actors.role: The 'world-class river restoration' framing as the depoliticised justification for clearing central riverbank land
actors.how_they_profit: Mega-project/eco-restoration branding supplies Ghosh's technocratic 'improvement' cover to assemble and clear central land at speed; the cleared riverfront becomes a planning/real-estate asset while the displaced subsidise it with their location and livelihoods.
actors.project: Cooum & Adyar restoration; Buckingham Canal banks
actors.claim: ANALYSIS: The Cooum/Adyar 'restoration' is the Chennai instance of mega-event/improvement-as-land-assembly: the un-priced central riverbank land occupied by the poor is the 'cheap-in' that 'restoration' converts into reclaimed public/real-estate space, with the cost borne as displacement to Perumbakkam/Kannagi Nagar. The HLRN study calls the resettlement-into-flood-path pattern evidence that the environmental rationale is, in part, a land rationale.
actors.source: Analytical synthesis of HLRN 'From Deluge to Displacement' and The Caravan 'Placing The Poor In The Flood Path'; framed against docs/the-corporate-city.md ('improvement' as depoliticisation).
actors.denial_if_any: Government maintains the projects are genuine flood-mitigation and ecological restoration with rehabilitation provided; the redevelopment-motive reading is the analysts', contested by the state.

actors.actor: OMR private developers + foreign/REIT capital (corridor real estate)
actors.role: Private developers along OMR and the global office/REIT capital that anchors the corridor's IT office stock
actors.how_they_profit: Capture the onward development uplift on state-manufactured corridor value, building high-FSI office/residential stock whose exit bid is provided by REIT/PE capital — the global liquidity that makes the domestic land-value capture bankable.
actors.project: OMR / Rajiv Gandhi Salai office and residential corridor (Madhya Kailash to Siruseri, ~20 km)
actors.claim: ANALYSIS: The ~20 km OMR stretch is value-capture financing in private hands: state road + IT-park + FSI-exemption investment manufactured the corridor's uplift; private developers and REIT/PE capital cash it out as office and residential real estate. Reported long-run land appreciation along the corridor (e.g. roughly 25-30% over five years at corridor nodes) tracks the publicly-created uplift, not private improvement.
actors.source: Hanu Reddy Realty / OMR market reporting; corridor land-rate appreciation data (tnguidelinevalue / locality reports); framed against the Tier-A FSI-exemption and SIPCOT facts above.
